sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedanta.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantam）。

sentences.en: Today's episode begins in a subterranean labyrinth.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目要从一个地下迷宫说起。

sentences.en: It's 2018, and we're below the streets of Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 那是2018年，我们身处华盛顿特区的街道下方。

sentences.en: I've come here in search of clues.
sentences.zh: 我来到这里是为了寻找线索。

sentences.en: So here we are in Deck 50 in the stacks of the Library of Congress.
sentences.zh: 我们现在位于国会图书馆书库的50号书架区。

sentences.en: I'm opening a door that's marked Door 20.
sentences.zh: 我正在打开一扇标着“20号门”的门。

sentences.en: My guide through the Library of Congress' massive collection is a tall, shaggy man.
sentences.zh: 带我参观国会图书馆庞大馆藏的向导，是一位身材高大、头发蓬乱的男士。

sentences.en: His name is Steve Winnick.
sentences.zh: 他叫史蒂夫·温尼克（Steve Winnick）。

sentences.en: He looks a lot like Hagrid from Harry Potter.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很像《哈利·波特》里的海格。

sentences.en: which seems about right for someone with a title of folkloriSt.
sentences.zh: 对于一个头衔是“民俗学家”的人来说，这倒挺合适。

sentences.en: Steve has already led me through a maze of low-ceiling stacks,
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫已经带我穿过了一片低矮的迷宫书架，

sentences.en: across a small bridge, and into a tiny elevator
sentences.zh: 走过一座小桥，进入了一部狭小的电梯，

sentences.en: where the flow numbers go up as we move down.
sentences.zh: 在那里，随着我们向下移动，楼层数字反而变大了。

sentences.en: Finally, we arrive at our destination.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们到达了目的地。

sentences.en: And in here, we find row upon row of collection boxes on the shelves,
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们看到书架上摆放着一排又一排的收藏盒，

sentences.en: and I'm looking for this collection, which is numbered AFC 1979-008.
sentences.zh: 我正在寻找这个编号为AFC 1979-008的收藏系列。

sentences.en: Steve pulls from the shelf a cardboard box.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫从架子上取下一个纸板箱。

sentences.en: Nobody's really used this collection very much,
sentences.zh: 几乎没人怎么用过这个收藏系列，

sentences.en: so it's simply, you know, been there waiting for you, really.
sentences.zh: 所以它就一直待在那儿，等着你，真的。

sentences.en: The author of this collection is Richard Riley Shepard,
sentences.zh: 这个收藏系列的作者是理查德·莱利·谢泼德（Richard Riley Shepard），

sentences.en: a small-time crook and conman who died in 2009.
sentences.zh: 一个在2009年去世的小混混和骗子。

sentences.en: I've been tracking Riley Shepard for a few months,
sentences.zh: 我已经追踪莱利·谢泼德好几个月了，

sentences.en: My assumption is that there's nothing of significance in the box.
sentences.zh: 我原本以为这个盒子里没什么重要的东西。

sentences.en: But I'm about to discover that the story I thought I was reporting is not, in fact, the full story.
sentences.zh: 但我即将发现，我以为自己在报道的故事，实际上并非全貌。

sentences.en: The story that's about to unfold before me is a story of obsession, its power, its beauty, and its costs.
sentences.zh: 即将展现在我面前的，是一个关于痴迷、它的力量、它的美及其代价的故事。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we bring you a classic episode about the peculiar life of a man named Riley Shepard.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，我们将为您带来一期经典节目，讲述一个名叫莱利·谢泼德的男人的奇特一生。

sentences.en: He was a musician and writer who spent decades on a single grand project.
sentences.zh: 他是一位音乐家兼作家，花了数十年时间完成了一个宏大的项目。

sentences.en: Whether that project was a great quest or a great folly,
sentences.zh: 至于那个项目究竟是伟大的追求还是愚蠢的行径，

sentences.en: that is for you to decide.
sentences.zh: 那得由你来评判。

sentences.en: He was a genius, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他是个天才。

sentences.en: He just was a compulsive liar.
sentences.zh: 他只是个撒谎成性的人。

sentences.en: He was quite a master.
sentences.zh: 他相当精明。

sentences.en: He was getting out of town before he was being tart and feathered.
sentences.zh: 他在被涂上焦油和羽毛示众之前就逃离了小镇。

sentences.en: I got to get this done.
sentences.zh: 我得把这事儿做完。

sentences.en: They all hated my guts.
sentences.zh: 他们都恨透了我。

sentences.en: I stumbled onto the story as I was contemplating an episode
sentences.zh: 我偶然发现了这个故事，当时我正在构思一期节目，

sentences.en: not about obsession, but about fallen heroes.
sentences.zh: 主题不是痴迷，而是陨落的英雄。

sentences.en: I'd asked Hidden Brain listeners to share examples from their own lives.
sentences.zh: 我曾请《隐藏的大脑》的听众分享他们生活中的例子。

sentences.zh: 其中一条留言……

sentences.en: I hope I did this right.

sentences.zh: ……来自斯塔莎·谢泼德-西尔弗曼（Stacia Shepard-Silverman）。

sentences.en: She said her fallen hero was her dad, Riley Shepard, whom she still loved.
sentences.zh: 她说她心目中陨落的英雄是她的父亲，莱利·谢泼德，她依然爱着他。

sentences.en: I want to say that I had a great relationship with my father.
sentences.zh: 我想说，我和父亲的关系非常好。

sentences.en: He was totally cool in many ways and a great cook.
sentences.zh: 他在很多方面都很酷，而且是个很棒的厨师。

sentences.en: When we talk, Stasha tells me that as a young girl, she idolized her dad.
sentences.zh: 当我们交谈时，斯塔莎告诉我，小时候她非常崇拜父亲。

sentences.en: She has memories of those days that feel like tiny, sparkling geMs.
sentences.zh: 她对那些日子的记忆就像一颗颗微小而闪亮的宝石。

sentences.en: My earliest memory of my dad is sitting on his lap and him smoking his cigar,
sentences.zh: 我最早关于父亲的记忆是坐在他腿上，看他抽雪茄，

sentences.en: and he would make cigar smoke rings for me.
sentences.zh: 他会为我吐出雪茄烟圈。

sentences.en: Stasha would watch them, transfixed, as they rose in the air before her.
sentences.zh: 斯塔莎会目不转睛地看着烟圈在面前升起。

sentences.en: I thought the smoke rings were magical.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那些烟圈有魔力。

sentences.en: There was a lot that was magical for Stasha back then.
sentences.zh: 那时候，对斯塔莎来说，有很多东西都充满魔力。

sentences.en: She still remembers their little apartment in Hollywood
sentences.zh: 她至今还记得他们在好莱坞的小公寓，

sentences.en: with the Siamese cat and the cat hair and the hardwood floors.
sentences.zh: 还有那只暹罗猫、猫毛和硬木地板。

sentences.en: She remembers how much she loved that her dad was around all the time.
sentences.zh: 她记得自己有多喜欢父亲一直陪在身边。

sentences.en: He didn't have a regular job.
sentences.zh: 他没有正经工作。

sentences.en: And he would sit in the middle of the living room usually
sentences.zh: 他通常会坐在客厅中央，

sentences.en: wherever we lived, and he would type.
sentences.zh: 无论我们住在哪里，他都会坐在那儿打字。

sentences.en: So he was working on things.
sentences.zh: 所以他一直在忙活些什么。

sentences.en: He was working on, I didn't know what,
sentences.zh: 他在忙什么，我不知道，

sentences.en: but I would sit under his desk sometimes
sentences.zh: 但我有时会坐在他的书桌底下，

sentences.en: while he typed away,
sentences.zh: 听着他打字的声音，

sentences.en: and we would talk in between the pages,
sentences.zh: 我们在打字间隙还会聊天，

sentences.en: and he would tell me things about show business.
sentences.zh: 他会跟我讲一些演艺圈的事情。

sentences.en: They were in their own little bubble,
sentences.zh: 他们生活在自己的小世界里，

sentences.en: Riley in his late 50s and his little daughter,
sentences.zh: 年近六旬的莱利和他的小女儿，

sentences.en: typing, talking, just being together.
sentences.zh: 打字、聊天，只是在一起。

sentences.en: Sometimes if Riley had a little money,
sentences.zh: 有时如果莱利手里有点钱，

sentences.en: he'd take Stasha out to eat at their favorite Hollywood hotspot,
sentences.zh: 他会带斯塔莎去他们最喜欢的“好莱坞热点”吃饭，

sentences.en: a restaurant called the Brown Derby.
sentences.zh: 那是一家叫“棕色德比”（Brown Derby）的餐厅。

sentences.en: It was a place where Riley could rub shoulders with famous people,
sentences.zh: 在那里，莱利可以和名人打成一片，

sentences.en: charm them with his warm southern accent,
sentences.zh: 用他那温暖的南方口音吸引他们，

sentences.en: and impress his daughter on their way home.
sentences.zh: 并在回家的路上给女儿留下深刻印象。

sentences.en: You know, the Hollywood stars were all around us.

sentences.en: We could walk up the street,
sentences.zh: 我们可以走在街上，

sentences.en: and my father would tell me about movie stars when we walked.
sentences.zh: 我父亲会在散步时跟我讲电影明星的事。

sentences.en: He seemed to know everything.
sentences.zh: 他好像什么都知道。

sentences.zh: 斯塔莎确信她的父亲自己也是个明星。

sentences.zh: 对于许多孩子来说，总有一个时刻，帷幕会被拉开，父母的真面目会显露出来，
